svg.text: OATI AutoRFP — Hybrid RAG with cross-encoder reranking, contextual-retrieval ingest, headless web scraping, and an opt-in LangGraph research agent.
Every AI layer is per-org configurable from the Admin Settings UI (Phase A). Cross-encoder + headless scrape + contextual retrieval shipped in Phase B. LangGraph agent shipped in Phase C.
